newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Century Insurance up 14.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Century Insurance up 14.2 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Century Insurance Company Ltd 10-rupee stock rose 3.00 rupees, or 14.2 percent, to 24 before the company's book closure from April 29 to May 12 for the entitlement of 25 percent bonus stocks for the year ended in December, brokers said.

The company's after-tax profit rose 71 percent to 12 million rupees in 1996 from seven million in 1995. The company paid 15 percent cash dividend and 25 percent bonus stocks for 1996 compared to 40 percent bonus stocks for 1995.
Some 1,500 shares changed hands in early trade at the Karachi Stock Exchange. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192.
